original_four_findings.title: 設定中樞標題與返回文案不隨語言切換
original_four_findings.trigger: 英文或其他非中文介面，開啟設定中樞；或切換語言後重新開啟。
causal_chain: SettingsHub 的 title 是 Component.literal("设置与更多")。
此兩個 Component 未引用語言資源；原版語言切換/reload 不會翻譯 literal。
original_four_findings.observed_scope: 源碼確定的固定文案；本輪沒有啟動客戶端取得英文截圖。
original_four_findings.repair_boundary_after_gate: 只涉及自有標題及通用返回標籤；原動作與畫面背景保留。

original_four_findings.title: 設定中樞縮放後以父主選單舊尺寸繪製背景
original_four_findings.trigger: 在設定中樞保持開啟的情況下調整視窗/GUI尺寸，例如邏輯視口由320×240擴至640×400。
causal_chain: Minecraft.resizeDisplay 只對當前 screen 呼叫 resize。
Screen.resize 更新當前物件 width/height 並重建控件；沒有遞迴更新 parent。
SettingsHub.render 呼叫 parent.renderArtwork(g)，而該方法用 parent.width、parent.height、parent.layout。
中樞面板及控件已用新尺寸，背景比例、漸層、邊框仍取父物件舊尺寸。
original_four_findings.observed_scope: 尺寸來源失同步由呼叫鏈確定；空白區/裁切等實際像素表現待靜音實機授權後驗收，不冒稱已看見。
original_four_findings.repair_boundary_after_gate: 讓設定頁繪製取當前視口，主選單原畫、裁切規則及原尺寸下效果保留；不能為同步背景重跑父主菜單 init 的服務初始化。

original_four_findings.title: Realms 通知圖示仍綁在已隱藏的主頁按鈕
original_four_findings.trigger: 正常非Demo帳號；Realms validClient 且有 unseen notification、邀請、新聞或試用等可繪製狀態。
causal_chain: arrange 隱藏所有按鈕，只恢復四個主操作；menu.online 仍存在但 visible=false。
主頁render只檢查 realms!=null 與 realmsLayer!=null，未按可見入口決定通知圖示所有權。
原版RealmsNotificationsScreen.render 在 validClient 為真時繪圖，並不讀本模組按鈕visible。
設定中樞另建可見Realms按鈕，只繪背景及自身widgets，沒有對應通知層。
original_four_findings.observed_scope: 源碼可確認層與可見入口分離；本輪未聯網查Realms、未注入帳號通知、未實機復現。
original_four_findings.repair_boundary_after_gate: 先確定通知應附著哪個可見入口；不可僅把原layer搬到Hub就宣稱完成，因原版getConfiguration還要求當前screen instanceof TitleScreen。

original_four_findings.title: Forge 模組更新圖示仍在主頁舊 Mods 按鈕位置繪製
original_four_findings.trigger: Forge 檢查結果 showNotification.shouldDraw() 為真，且 VERSION_CHECK 開啟。
causal_chain: Mods按鈕被主頁arrange隱藏；syncOriginalBounds只同步其幾何，未把通知所有權轉到中樞可見按鈕。
Forge layer通過通知狀態及設定檢查後直接讀modButton幾何繪圖，沒有visible檢查。
original_four_findings.observed_scope: 有更新狀態時會發生的源碼問題；本輪未檢查更新服務或造通知事件。
original_four_findings.repair_boundary_after_gate: 通知與當前可見Mods入口同步，並保留Forge更新開關；不改全局更新機制。

old_business_before_new_source: Complete four original UI findings plus complete five UI examples/support were read before these new native full classes; old program references are not imported into UI count.

independent_judgments.observation: getConfiguration requires current minecraft.screen instanceof TitleScreen plus validClient. Options select showAll or onlyNotifications, not total notification disable.
independent_judgments.implication: Moving layer rendering to SettingsHub (Screen subclass) alone does not move its data subscription lifecycle.

independent_judgments.observation: TitleScreen.tick forwards layer tick. SettingsHub inherits empty Screen.tick. If a future hub merely forwards layer.tick, native getConfiguration still returns null in that hub.
independent_judgments.implication: Presentation relocation and subscription eligibility are distinct obligations; no real service test was performed.

independent_judgments.observation: render gates by validClient. Unseen icon uses static cached hasUnseenNotifications without currentConfiguration check. News/invites/trial additionally require nonnull configuration and showOldNotifications.
independent_judgments.implication: Cached icons and refresh eligibility must not be conflated. No assertion that all icon types render in every state.

independent_judgments.observation: Icon coordinates use notification-layer own width/height, vanilla center anchor and left-growing icon budget. Dynasty translates that layer relative to a retained hidden menu.online button.
independent_judgments.implication: Target viewport, actual visible owner and reserved icon width all require explicit alignment; graphics translation alone is insufficient lifecycle repair.

independent_judgments.observation: TitleScreen.init creates or reinitializes existing Realms layer; layer.init may availability-check and force-update subscription. added resets notificationsTask. Constructor/service side effects are source facts only.
independent_judgments.implication: Refreshing parent initialization merely to fix hub background dimensions risks unrelated lifecycle work and must be avoided.

independent_judgments.observation: Forge indicator captures final original modButton. init checks updates once per indicator instance when button nonnull, sets hasCheckedForUpdates. render checks status/showDraw/config and then reads button geometry; no visible test.
independent_judgments.implication: A relocated visible wrapper is not automatically indicator owner. Preserve VERSION_CHECK gate and existing update service behavior.

independent_judgments.observation: arrange hides Mods and Realms main buttons; main render calls both layers. Hub constructs new wrappers over originals, but renderWidget does not sync original bounds; only initial main init syncs hidden Mods geometry.
independent_judgments.implication: Existing known UI-20261101-03/-04 confirmed as source-owned conditional placement bugs, not two new semantic references.

independent_judgments.observation: Screen transition removed/added/init and resize-driven reposition use current screen. Current hub has own geometry; parent object is a return target and is not recursively resized.
independent_judgments.implication: Known resize bug should ultimately use current viewport without calling parent init or drawing new background art. No fix performed while gate false.

independent_judgments.observation: Selected source also exposed incidental nearby setOverlay/destroy/partial close, cursorEntered/FPS and start of wrapScreenError.
independent_judgments.implication: These incidental lines do not constitute full ancestor methods or accepted new chains; full Screen646/Minecraft class not claimed.
